summary: The ConnectionFailed feature handles the display of a user interface when a connection failure occurs. It manages localization for English and French, controls page layout and navigational elements, and displays error messages.
purpose: To provide a user-friendly interface for users encountering a connection failure, with support for English and French languages.

fields.name: HeaderEN
fields.description: Panel control for English language interface

fields.name: HeaderFR
fields.description: Panel control for French language interface

fields.name: uxErrorMessage
fields.description: Label control for displaying the connection failed message

workflows.name: Connection Failure Display
steps: The system checks the 'Locale' query parameter to determine language.
HeaderEN is made visible if the locale is 'en-US' or is not specified.
HeaderFR is made visible if the locale is 'fr-CA'.
The appropriate error message is displayed using the uxErrorMessage label.

business_rules: Display HeaderEN panel when locale is 'en-US' or unspecified.
Display HeaderFR panel when locale is 'fr-CA'.
conditions: Locale query parameter is checked to determine language preference.
system_behavior: The system dynamically adjusts the user interface language based on the locale.
Error message display is controlled via resource localization.
